acsl-annotation-assistant.name: ACSL 注解助手
acsl-annotation-assistant.description: 为 C/C++ 程序创建 ACSL（ANSI/ISO C 规范语言）形式化注解。用于形式化验证、添加函数契约（requires/ensures）、循环不变量、断言、内存安全注解或任何 ACSL 规范。

ambiguity-detector.name: 歧义检测器
ambiguity-detector.description: 检测和分析软件需求和用户故事中的模糊语言。用于审查需求文档、用户故事、规范或任何软件需求文本，以识别可能导致误解的模糊表述。

api-design-assistant.name: API 设计助手
api-design-assistant.description: 设计和审查 API，提供端点、参数、返回类型和最佳实践建议。用于从需求设计新 API、审查现有 API 设计、生成 API 文档或验证 API 一致性。

api-documentation-generator.name: API 文档生成器
api-documentation-generator.description: 从仓库源代码生成全面的 API 文档，包括 OpenAPI 规范、代码注释、文档字符串和现有文档。用于记录 API、创建 API 参考指南或从代码库总结 API 功能。

assertion-synthesizer.name: 断言合成器
assertion-synthesizer.description: 为自动化测试用例生成断言。支持简单和复杂的断言，适用于多种编程语言。用于为未测试的代码添加测试、增强现有测试或捕获实际行为。

bug-localization.name: Bug 定位器
bug-localization.description: 在源代码、模块和系统中识别 bug 的精确位置。用于调试应用程序、调查测试失败、分析错误报告、追踪运行时问题或执行根本原因分析。

bug-to-patch-generator.name: Bug 到补丁生成器
bug-to-patch-generator.description: 为识别的 bug 生成补丁。创建最小修复，包含修复的测试用例。

cd-pipeline-generator.name: CD 流水线生成器
cd-pipeline-generator.description: 创建用于自动化部署的 CD 流水线配置。支持 AWS、GCP 和 Azure 云平台，包含环境分离、审批门和回滚功能。

change-log-generator.name: 变更日志生成器
change-log-generator.description: 从提交创建变更日志。按类型分类变更，遵循语义化版本控制。

ci-pipeline-synthesizer.name: CI 流水线合成器
ci-pipeline-synthesizer.description: 生成用于自动化构建和测试的 CI 流水线配置。支持 GitHub Actions，包含依赖缓存和矩阵测试。包含 Node.js、Python、Go 和 Rust 项目的模板。

code-change-summarizer.name: 代码变更摘要器
code-change-summarizer.description: 从代码变更生成结构化的拉取请求描述。记录带有迁移指南的破坏性变更，添加测试说明和上下文增强。

code-comment-generator.name: 代码注释生成器
code-comment-generator.description: 为代码生成清晰、有用的注释。分析代码逻辑、参数、返回值和副作用，生成符合项目风格的文档注释。

code-optimizer.name: 代码优化器
code-optimizer.description: 优化代码性能和效率。识别性能瓶颈、建议算法改进、优化数据结构使用，并提供更高效的实现方案。

code-pattern-extractor.name: 代码模式提取器
code-pattern-extractor.description: 分析代码库以识别可重用的代码模式和重复代码。生成包含重构建议的模式目录，为高价值模式创建可重用的模板代码。

code-refactoring-assistant.name: 代码重构助手
code-refactoring-assistant.description: 协助代码重构以提高可维护性和代码质量。建议重构机会、应用设计模式、消除代码异味，并保持功能等价性。

code-review-assistant.name: 代码审查助手
code-review-assistant.description: 执行全面的代码审查。检查代码质量、安全漏洞、性能问题、最佳实践违规，并提供改进建议。

code-search-assistant.name: 代码搜索助手
code-search-assistant.description: 在仓库中搜索与给定代码片段相关的代码。根据调用链、文本和功能相似性对结果进行排名，输出带有匹配代码片段的排名文件列表。

code-smell-detector.name: 代码异味检测器
code-smell-detector.description: 检测代码中的异味和反模式。识别长方法、重复代码、复杂条件、紧耦合等问题，并建议重构策略。

code-translation.name: 代码翻译
code-translation.description: 在语言之间翻译代码。保持功能，适应目标语言习惯用法。

component-boundary-identifier.name: 组件边界识别器
component-boundary-identifier.description: 识别模块/组件边界。检测边界违规，分析架构分离。

conflict-analyzer.name: 冲突分析器
conflict-analyzer.description: 分析合并冲突。建议冲突解决方案，解释冲突的变更。

containerization-assistant.name: 容器化助手
containerization-assistant.description: 创建 Dockerfile 和容器配置。优化容器镜像，支持多阶段构建。

counterexample-explainer.name: 反例解释器
counterexample-explainer.description: 解释反例。提供调试见解，建议修复方法。

counterexample-generator.name: 反例生成器
counterexample-generator.description: 为失败的证明生成反例。从反例创建测试用例，帮助理解验证失败。

coverage-enhancer.name: 覆盖率增强器
coverage-enhancer.description: 提高测试覆盖率。分析未覆盖的代码路径，生成额外的测试用例以提高分支覆盖率、语句覆盖率和条件覆盖率。

dead-code-eliminator.name: 死代码消除器
dead-code-eliminator.description: 识别和移除死代码。检测未使用的函数、变量、导入和代码块，帮助清理代码库并减少维护负担。

dependency-resolver.name: 依赖解析器
dependency-resolver.description: 解决依赖冲突。建议兼容版本，分析依赖树。

deprecated-api-updater.name: 废弃 API 更新器
deprecated-api-updater.description: 更新废弃的 API 使用。建议现代替代方案，自动化 API 迁移。

design-pattern-suggestor.name: 设计模式建议器
design-pattern-suggestor.description: 根据问题描述、需求或代码场景推荐合适的软件设计模式。分析问题上下文，建议适合的创建型、结构型、行为型、架构型或并发模式，并提供实现指导和权衡分析。

design-smell-detector.name: 设计异味检测器
design-smell-detector.description: 识别架构和设计问题。检测设计原则违规，建议设计改进。

directed-test-input-generator.name: 定向测试输入生成器
directed-test-input-generator.description: 生成针对性的测试输入。专注于特定代码路径，使用符号执行技术。

edge-case-generator.name: 边缘用例生成器
edge-case-generator.description: 为函数和方法生成边缘用例测试。识别边界条件、极端值、空输入、特殊字符等，确保代码健壮性。

environment-setup-assistant.name: 环境设置助手
environment-setup-assistant.description: 生成环境设置脚本。管理依赖和配置，支持多个平台。

error-explanation-generator.name: 错误解释生成器
error-explanation-generator.description: 解释错误消息。提供上下文和解决方案，帮助调试。

flaky-test-detector.name: 不稳定测试检测器
flaky-test-detector.description: 检测和分析不稳定的测试。识别间歇性失败的测试，分析失败模式，并建议修复策略以提高测试可靠性。

function-class-generator.name: 函数类生成器
function-class-generator.description: 从规范生成函数和类。支持多种编程语言，包含类型提示、文档和错误处理。

fuzzing-input-generator.name: 模糊输入生成器
fuzzing-input-generator.description: 创建随机化测试输入。发现意外行为，支持基于变异的模糊测试。

incremental-java-programmer.name: 增量 Java 编程器
incremental-java-programmer.description: 根据自然语言描述在 Java 仓库中实现新功能。支持 Maven 和 Gradle 构建系统，生成 JUnit 测试并确保所有测试成功通过。

incremental-python-programmer.name: 增量 Python 编程器
incremental-python-programmer.description: 根据自然语言描述在 Python 仓库中实现新功能。生成全面的单元测试和集成测试，确保所有测试通过并遵循现有代码模式。

integration-test-generator.name: 集成测试生成器
integration-test-generator.description: 生成集成测试以验证组件间的交互。创建测试场景来验证模块集成、API 调用、数据库交互和外部服务集成。

invariant-inference.name: 不变量推断器
invariant-inference.description: 推断循环和程序不变量。使用静态和动态分析，验证推断的不变量。

java-test-updater.name: Java 测试更新器
java-test-updater.description: 在重构后更新 Java 测试以适配新代码版本。处理签名变更、重构和行为修改，更新方法调用、断言、模拟对象并确保测试通过。

legacy-code-summarizer.name: 遗留代码摘要器
legacy-code-summarizer.description: 总结遗留代码库。解释代码功能，帮助理解旧代码。

markdown-document-structurer.name: Markdown 文档结构器
markdown-document-structurer.description: 将 Markdown 文档重组为结构良好的格式。修复标题层次结构并生成目录，标准化格式并提高可读性。

module-component-generator.name: 模块组件生成器
module-component-generator.description: 从接口契约构建完整模块。生成分层架构（模型、仓储、服务），支持 Python 和 Java 的设计模式。

nl-to-constraints.name: 自然语言到约束
nl-to-constraints.description: 将自然语言需求转换为形式化约束。支持约束语言，验证约束一致性。

python-repo-quickstart.name: Python 仓库快速开始
python-repo-quickstart.description: 快速分析 Python 仓库。识别项目类型、入口点和依赖项，生成设置和执行说明。

python-test-updater.name: Python 测试更新器
python-test-updater.description: 更新 Python 测试以适配新代码版本。修复由于签名和行为变更导致的测试失败，分析代码差异并相应更新断言。

readme-generator.name: README 生成器
readme-generator.description: 生成全面、用户友好的 README.md 文件。包含项目介绍、先决条件和设置说明，提供可执行的使用示例和仓库结构概览。

regression-root-cause-analyzer.name: 回归根因分析器
regression-root-cause-analyzer.description: 分析回归失败。识别根本原因，建议修复方法。

release-notes-writer.name: 发布说明编写器
release-notes-writer.description: 编写发布说明。突出新功能和修复，面向最终用户。

req-to-test.name: 需求到测试
req-to-test.description: 将需求转换为测试用例。确保需求覆盖，将测试追溯到需求。

requirement-comparison-reporter.name: 需求比较报告器
requirement-comparison-reporter.description: 比较新旧需求文档。将需求变更映射到代码组件，生成详细的 Markdown 格式修改计划。

requirement-coverage-checker.name: 需求覆盖率检查器
requirement-coverage-checker.description: 检查需求覆盖。识别实现中的差距，将需求追溯到代码。

requirement-summarizer.name: 需求摘要器
requirement-summarizer.description: 总结和提取软件需求文档的关键信息。分析需求规范、用户故事和功能描述，生成简洁的摘要和关键点。

rollback-strategy-advisor.name: 回滚策略顾问
rollback-strategy-advisor.description: 建议回滚策略。规划部署回退，最小化停机时间。

runtime-error-explainer.name: 运行时错误解释器
runtime-error-explainer.description: 解释运行时错误。提供调试指导，建议修复方法。

scenario-generator.name: 场景生成器
scenario-generator.description: 生成使用场景。创建用户故事，开发测试场景。

specification-driven-generation.name: 规范驱动生成
specification-driven-generation.description: 从形式化规范生成代码。确保规范合规性，验证生成的代码是否符合需求。

specification-generator.name: 规范生成器
specification-generator.description: 生成形式化规范。将自然语言转换为规范，验证规范完整性。

static-reasoning-verifier.name: 静态推理验证器
static-reasoning-verifier.description: 使用静态分析验证代码。检查正确性属性，报告验证结果。

symbolic-execution-assistant.name: 符号执行助手
symbolic-execution-assistant.description: 协助符号执行。生成路径约束，探索执行路径。

system-diagram-generator.name: 系统图生成器
system-diagram-generator.description: 创建系统架构图。支持 Mermaid、PlantUML、Graphviz，生成数据流和部署图。

technical-debt-analyzer.name: 技术债务分析器
technical-debt-analyzer.description: 检测和分析具有高维护成本、糟糕设计或累积技术债务的区域。用于审查代码库质量问题、规划重构工作、进行代码审计、评估项目健康状况、识别维护热点或优先处理技术改进。

template-code-generator.name: 模板代码生成器
template-code-generator.description: 从模板创建样板代码。支持常见模式和框架，可定制的模板适用于不同用例。

test-case-documentation.name: 测试用例文档
test-case-documentation.description: 记录测试用例及其目的。解释测试场景和预期结果，维护测试文档。

test-driven-generation.name: 测试驱动生成
test-driven-generation.description: 从测试用例生成实现。遵循 TDD 原则，确保测试覆盖率。

test-oracle-generator.name: 测试预言生成器
test-oracle-generator.description: 为测试用例生成预期输出。创建断言和验证逻辑，支持基于属性的测试。

test-suite-prioritizer.name: 测试套件优先级器
test-suite-prioritizer.description: 优先排序测试执行顺序。优化早期故障检测，考虑测试依赖关系和覆盖率。

unit-test-generator.name: 单元测试生成器
unit-test-generator.description: 为函数和方法生成单元测试。分析代码逻辑，创建测试用例覆盖正常路径、边缘情况和错误条件，支持多种测试框架。

configuration-generator.name: 配置生成器
configuration-generator.description: 生成配置文件。支持多种格式（YAML、JSON、XML），验证配置模式。

abstract-domain-explorer.name: 抽象域探索器
abstract-domain-explorer.description: 使用不同的抽象域（区间、八边形、多面体、符号、同余）对程序变量进行静态分析，推断不变量、值范围和关系。用于分析程序属性、推断循环不变量、检测潜在错误或通过静态分析理解变量关系。

abstract-invariant-generator.name: 抽象不变量生成器
abstract-invariant-generator.description: 使用抽象解释自动推断循环不变量、函数前置条件和后置条件，用于形式化验证。生成捕获程序行为的不变量，支持 Dafny、Isabelle、Coq 等验证系统的正确性证明。

abstract-state-analyzer.name: 抽象状态分析器
abstract-state-analyzer.description: 对源代码执行抽象解释，在不执行程序的情况下推断可能的程序状态、变量范围和数据属性。报告潜在的运行时错误，包括越界访问、空指针引用、类型不一致、除零和整数溢出。

abstract-trace-summarizer.name: 抽象追踪摘要器
abstract-trace-summarizer.description: 执行抽象解释以生成摘要的执行轨迹和高级程序行为表示。突出显示关键控制流路径、变量关系、循环不变量、函数契约和抽象状态转换。

appcircle-automation.name: AppCircle 自动化
appcircle-automation.description: Automate Appcircle tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

appveyor-automation.name: AppVeyor 自动化
appveyor-automation.description: Automate Appveyor tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

artifacts-builder.name: 构件构建器
artifacts-builder.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.

behavior-preservation-checker.name: 行为保持检查器
behavior-preservation-checker.description: Compare runtime behavior between original and migrated repositories to detect behavioral differences, regressions, and semantic changes. Use when validating code migrations, refactorings, language ports, framework upgrades, or any transformation that should preserve behavior. Automatically compares test results, execution traces, API responses, and observable outputs between two repository versions. Provides actionable guidance for fixing deviations and ensuring behavioral equivalence.

bisect-aware-instrumentation.name: 二分感知插桩
bisect-aware-instrumentation.description: Instrument code to support efficient git bisect by producing deterministic pass/fail signals and concise runtime summaries for each tested commit. Use when debugging regressions with git bisect, automating bisect workflows, creating bisect test scripts, handling flaky tests during bisection, or needing clear exit codes and logging for automated bisect runs. Helps identify the exact commit that introduced a bug through automated testing.

bitbucket-automation.name: BitBucket 自动化
bitbucket-automation.description: Automate Bitbucket repositories, pull requests, branches, issues, and workspace management via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

bug-history-summarizer.name: Bug 历史摘要器
bug-history-summarizer.description: Summarizes the complete lifecycle of a bug across code versions, tracking its introduction, detection, fixing attempts, and regression history. Use when users need to: (1) Understand how a bug evolved over time, (2) Trace when and how a bug was introduced, (3) Analyze fix attempts and their effectiveness, (4) Identify regression patterns, (5) Generate bug lifecycle reports for documentation or post-mortems. Takes a repository, bug identifier, and version history as input.

bug-reproduction-test-generator.name: Bug 重现测试生成器
bug-reproduction-test-generator.description: 为报告的 bug 生成可重现的测试用例。分析 bug 报告、堆栈跟踪和错误消息，创建最小化的测试用例来一致地重现问题。

bugbug-automation.name: BugBug 自动化
bugbug-automation.description: Automate Bugbug tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

bugherd-automation.name: BugHerd 自动化
bugherd-automation.description: Automate Bugherd tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

bugsnag-automation.name: Bugsnag 自动化
bugsnag-automation.description: Automate Bugsnag tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

build-ci-migration-assistant.name: 构建 CI 迁移助手
build-ci-migration-assistant.description: Automatically migrates build systems and CI/CD configurations to target platforms. Use when modernizing build infrastructure, switching CI/CD providers, or standardizing across projects. Supports common migration paths including Maven↔Gradle, npm↔Yarn, Travis CI→GitHub Actions, CircleCI→GitHub Actions, Jenkins→GitLab CI, and GitLab CI→GitHub Actions. Analyzes existing configuration, generates equivalent target configuration, maps dependencies and commands, and provides validation and migration documentation.

buildkite-automation.name: BuildKite 自动化
buildkite-automation.description: Automate Buildkite tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

c-cpp-to-lean4-translator.name: C/C++ 到 Lean4 转换器
c-cpp-to-lean4-translator.description: Translate C or C++ programs into equivalent Lean4 code, preserving program semantics and ensuring the generated code is well-typed, executable, and can run successfully. Use when the user asks to convert C/C++ code to Lean4, port C/C++ programs to Lean4, translate imperative code to functional Lean4, or create Lean4 versions of C/C++ algorithms.

circleci-automation.name: CircleCI 自动化
circleci-automation.description: Automate CircleCI tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): trigger pipelines, monitor workflows/jobs, retrieve artifacts and test metadata. Always search tools first for current schemas.

cloudflare-api-key-automation.name: Cloudflare API 密钥自动化
cloudflare-api-key-automation.description: Automate Cloudflare API tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

cloudflare-automation.name: Cloudflare 自动化
cloudflare-automation.description: Automate Cloudflare tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

cloudflare-browser-rendering-automation.name: Cloudflare 浏览器渲染自动化
cloudflare-browser-rendering-automation.description: Automate Cloudflare Browser Rendering tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

static-bug-detector.description: Analyze source code statically to detect potential functional bugs including null dereferences, incorrect condition checks, unreachable code, inconsistent state updates, logic errors, resource leaks, and type mismatches. Report suspicious code locations with detailed explanations, severity levels, and confidence assessments. Use when reviewing code for bugs, performing code audits, or when the user asks to find bugs, detect issues, analyze code for problems, or perform static analysis.

static-vulnerability-detector.name: 静态漏洞检测器
static-vulnerability-detector.description: Statically analyze code to detect security vulnerabilities including buffer overflows, injection risks (SQL, command, XSS), insecure deserialization, improper authentication, hard-coded credentials, and unsafe cryptography. Use when: (1) Performing security code review, (2) Analyzing code for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, (3) Identifying CWE-classified weaknesses, (4) Generating security audit reports, (5) Reviewing code before deployment, or (6) Assessing third-party code security. Findings categorized by CWE ID and severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

supabase-automation.name: Supabase 自动化
supabase-automation.description: Automate Supabase database queries, table management, project administration, storage, edge functions, and SQL execution via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

szz-bug-identifier.name: SZZ Bug 识别器
szz-bug-identifier.description: 使用 SZZ 风格分析识别引入 bug 的提交，基于 bug 修复提交、提交历史和代码归属信息。用于追溯 bug 到其起源、识别哪些提交引入了 bug、分析 bug 修复提交以找到根本原因、执行软件仓库挖掘进行 bug 分析或进行软件缺陷的实证研究。

tactic-suggestion-assistant.name: 策略建议助手
tactic-suggestion-assistant.description: Analyze proof states in Isabelle or Coq and suggest applicable tactics to make progress. Use when users need help with: (1) Choosing the next tactic in an interactive proof, (2) Understanding what tactics apply to their current goal, (3) Getting unstuck in a proof, (4) Learning which tactics work for specific goal structures (conjunctions, implications, induction, etc.). Provides 3-5 ranked tactic suggestions with explanations for intermediate-level proofs in both Isabelle/Isar and Coq.

taint-instrumentation-assistant.name: Taint 插桩 助手
taint-instrumentation-assistant.description: Instruments code to track the flow of untrusted or sensitive data at runtime, enabling detection of injection vulnerabilities, data leaks, and privilege violations. Use when users need to: (1) Track untrusted input propagation through code, (2) Detect SQL injection, XSS, or command injection vulnerabilities, (3) Identify sensitive data leaks, (4) Monitor privilege escalation paths, (5) Perform dynamic taint analysis for security testing. Supports Python, Java, JavaScript, and C/C++ with configurable taint sources and sinks.

test-app-automation.name: 测试应用自动化
test-app-automation.description: Automate Test App tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

test-case-reducer.name: 测试 用例 Reducer
test-case-reducer.description: Automatically reduces bug-triggering test cases to minimal form while preserving the failure. Use when debugging with large, complex test cases that need simplification, reproducing bugs with minimal examples, or creating regression tests from verbose failure scenarios. Takes a failing test and systematically removes unnecessary inputs, steps, assertions, and code using delta debugging and other reduction algorithms. Supports unit tests, integration tests, input files, and multiple programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C/C++).

test-deduplicator.name: 测试去重器
test-deduplicator.description: 分析测试套件，使用覆盖率分析、语义相似度和执行结果识别冗余和重复的测试用例。用于减少测试套件大小、识别冗余测试、优化测试执行时间、分析测试覆盖率重叠、查找具有相同行为的测试或提高测试套件可维护性。

test-guided-bug-detector.name: 测试引导 Bug 检测器
test-guided-bug-detector.description: Analyze failing tests to detect functional bugs in code. Takes repository and failing test output as input, analyzes execution behavior, assertions, and stack traces to identify suspicious code regions and root causes. Use when debugging test failures, investigating regression bugs, or understanding why tests fail. Explains the bug mechanism, identifies affected code, and suggests fixes based on test expectations vs actual behavior.

test-guided-debloating.name: 测试 引导 Debloating
test-guided-debloating.description: Removes unnecessary code from a repository while preserving exactly the behavior exercised by a given test suite. Use this skill when you need to debloat, slim down, or remove unused code from a codebase based on test coverage. The skill analyzes which code elements (files, classes, functions, methods, branches, imports) are exercised by tests, identifies unreachable or unused code, and safely removes it while ensuring all tests continue to pass. Triggers when users ask to remove unused code, debloat based on tests, eliminate dead code guided by test coverage, or slim down a repository to only test-required functionality.

test-guided-migration-assistant.name: 测试 引导 迁移 助手
test-guided-migration-assistant.description: Automatically updates a codebase to a new language version, framework version, or library update while ensuring all tests still pass. Use this skill when migrating Python 2→3, upgrading framework versions (React, Django, Angular), updating dependencies, or performing any version migration where tests define correct behavior. The skill analyzes failing tests caused by migration, categorizes errors (import errors, API changes, type errors, behavior changes), proposes systematic fixes, and verifies that test-observable behavior remains unchanged. Triggers when users ask to migrate code versions, upgrade dependencies while keeping tests passing, update framework versions, or perform test-guided version migrations.

trace-collection-assistant.name: 追踪 Collection 助手
trace-collection-assistant.description: Collect, normalize, and structure execution traces from instrumented programs (strace, ltrace) into JSON format for downstream analysis. Use when working with system call traces, library call traces, or execution logs that need to be analyzed for debugging, test case reproduction, or verification. Supports parsing strace/ltrace output, filtering noise, extracting debug information, and preparing traces for bug analysis or reproduction workflows.

traceability-matrix-generator.name: Traceability Matrix 生成器
traceability-matrix-generator.description: Builds traceability matrices connecting requirements to design documents to source code implementation, tracking the complete development lifecycle. Use when you need to verify implementation completeness, ensure all requirements are implemented in code, generate compliance documentation, audit requirement coverage, identify orphaned code, or create traceability reports for stakeholders. Supports parsing requirements from Markdown, Word, and PDFs; extracting design from architecture docs and API specs; and scanning source code for implementations. Outputs to Markdown tables, Excel/CSV, and HTML visualizations.

vercel-automation.name: Vercel 自动化
vercel-automation.description: Automate Vercel tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): manage deployments, domains, DNS, env vars, projects, and teams. Always search tools first for current schemas.

verification-boundary-reporter.name: 验证边界报告器
verification-boundary-reporter.description: Analyze formal verification artifacts (Isabelle, Coq, Dafny, etc.) and produce structured reports identifying the precise boundary between verified, assumed, and unverified components. Use when assessing verification coverage, understanding trust boundaries, auditing formal proofs, or documenting verification scope. Reports explicitly list verified code, assumptions, axioms, trusted computing base, and unverified components. Conservative and explicit about verification status without attempting to repair or mask gaps.

verified-pseudocode-extractor.name: 已验证伪代码提取器
verified-pseudocode-extractor.description: Extract language-agnostic pseudocode from formally verified programs (Isabelle/HOL, Coq) while preserving verified control flow, data dependencies, and algorithmic logic. Use when: (1) Users have verified code and need readable pseudocode, (2) Documenting verified algorithms for broader audiences, (3) Translating verified implementations to other languages, (4) Creating algorithm specifications from verified code, (5) Preserving verification guarantees in pseudocode form, or (6) Abstracting proof-heavy code to essential logic. Maintains semantic faithfulness to verified implementation.

verified-spec-code-mapper.name: 已验证规范代码映射器
verified-spec-code-mapper.description: Establish explicit traceability between formal specifications (preconditions, postconditions, invariants) and verified code components with their correctness proofs. Produce structured Markdown mapping reports showing verification coverage and proof evidence. Use when auditing formal verification, documenting verified systems, establishing traceability for certification, or when the user asks to map specifications to code, generate verification reports, or analyze verification coverage in Coq, Dafny, Isabelle, or other proof assistants.

vulnerability-pattern-matcher.name: 漏洞模式匹配器
vulnerability-pattern-matcher.description: Detects security vulnerabilities by matching code against known vulnerability patterns, insecure coding idioms, and CVE-style patterns. Explains why patterns are risky and under what conditions they are exploitable. Use when analyzing code for security issues, reviewing for common vulnerabilities, or assessing exploitability of suspicious code patterns.

vulnerability-root-cause-analyzer.name: 漏洞根因分析器
vulnerability-root-cause-analyzer.description: Analyze vulnerable code to identify underlying root causes such as violated assumptions, incorrect invariants, missing validation checks, or unsafe component interactions. Use when investigating security vulnerabilities, CVEs, exploit code, or security audit findings. Infers why the vulnerability exists beyond surface symptoms, identifies systemic issues, and explains the chain of failures that enable exploitation.

web-artifacts-builder.name: Web 构件构建器
web-artifacts-builder.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.

webapp-testing.name: Web 应用测试
webapp-testing.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

behavioral-mutation-analyzer.name: 行为变异分析器
behavioral-mutation-analyzer.description: 通过变异测试分析程序行为变化。生成语义变异以测试程序的行为等价性，识别功能差异和潜在的回归问题。
